name: Should I hire a professional or hang basement drywall myself?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a professional or hang basement drywall myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hanging basement drywall requires specialized tools and heavy lifting, but the most challenging part is achieving a smooth, seamless finish. A professional crew ensures panels are hung tightly, screw depths are precise without breaking paper facing, and ceiling seams align properly. Mudding and taping require significant technique; uneven coats result in visible joints, sanding ridges, and rough spots once paint is applied. Hiring a professional contractor like HH Remodeling saves time, minimizes dust across your living areas, and delivers flat walls ready for primer and trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional is recommended because hanging is heavy labor and taping requires significant skill to prevent visible joints and uneven walls.
